test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Neem tastes / a little bitterly, / but is very useful.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1) "a little bitterly".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the use of "**bitterly**"
